meta.description: Registry for bounded residue transport dissipation and conservation-leakage conditions in Phase 3.

residue_dissipation_entries.name: Residue Transport Dissipation Bounds
residue_dissipation_entries.purpose: Represent bounded residue transport dissipation and admissibility-sensitive conservation leakage across recursive continuation systems.

residue_dissipation_conditions.name: residue_transport_dissipation_remains_defined
residue_dissipation_conditions.description: Formal metrics must exist to track the loss or dispersion of residue measure during nonlocal transport.

residue_dissipation_conditions.name: conservation_leakage_behavior_remains_detectable
residue_dissipation_conditions.description: The system must maintain formal predicates to identify where exact conservation fails due to leakage.

residue_dissipation_conditions.name: recursive_residue_updates_remain_admissible
residue_dissipation_conditions.description: Dissipative residue transitions must satisfy current admissibility windows at each step.

residue_dissipation_conditions.name: nonlocal_transport_does_not_force_exact_conservation
residue_dissipation_conditions.description: Propagating influence acrossInteraction domains does not imply lossless residue persistence.

residue_dissipation_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_residue_decay_remains_bounded
residue_dissipation_conditions.description: Drift in residue decay rates triggered by frame orientation must stay within stability thresholds.

residue_dissipation_conditions.name: transition_flux_under_residue_transport_remains_finite
residue_dissipation_conditions.description: Dissipative transport must ensure that realization measure does not diverge under recursion.

residue_dissipation_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_residue_transport_witness
residue_dissipation_conditions.description: Pruning of highly dissipative states must not eliminate all valid residue-coupled paths.

residue_dissipation_conditions.name: residue_transport_instability_remains_detectable
residue_dissipation_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to detect and register the breakdown of balance bounds or runaway leakage.
